notes.title: Bouncemasters Demo Next Fest Challenge: Penguin-Launching Leaderboard!
notes.notes: [h3]Think you’re the ultimate penguin-launcher? It’s time to prove it! [/h3][p]During the Next Fest (June 9–16), everyone is invited to climb to the top of the Bouncemasters Demo leaderboard.  [/p][p][/p][p]When the event ends on June 16, our three most legendary bouncers will earn some sweet loot:[/p][p]🥇 1st Place – $25 Steam Gift Card  [/p][p]🥈 2nd Place – $10 Steam Gift Card  [/p][p]🥉 3rd Place – $5 Steam Gift Card[/p][p][/p][p]No cheating, just pure flipper-powered arcade skill and maybe a little bit of penguin luck.  [/p][p][b]Ready, set… BOUNCE![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]And don't forget to join our [url="https://discord.gg/8kDBMSf7VF"]discord[/url] - we are building a sweet-little-pengu community there![/i][/p]
